Lucas Artesano - gunsmith Raiders, patrolled by the strongest at the moment, 6-8 lvl mobs.
- New mobs with new vehicles and weapons.
- New quests in new locations, the performance of which can reduce karma.

notes.title: Update v.0.132.4050
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28531570/7014d0a3adad282365c1dd93c2666c04c344c112.png

Many thanks to those who left the positive reviews despite the lack of balance and gameplay as such, it is very important for us right now. We work for you, not for money ;)
Ladies and gentlemen, the first update after the opening of Early Access:

- Added a character wipe button in the personal account.
- Increased speed and dynamics of vehicles.
- Automatic distribution of players by servers is removed.
- Improved hardware performance of the European server.
- Added the effect of shaking when get hit by a large-caliber fire (optional)
- The screen is now slightly untied from the center (optional)
- Added division of damage when hit in multiple targets by non-automatic guns depending on the skill of shooting.
- The problem with the authorization error via Steam has been fixed.
- The assortment system was introduced at the auto dealers.
- The system of randomization of vehicle characteristics has been added. Now you can buy an absolutely unique vehicle.
- Added two new locations: Tartron Parts, Adriano Customs.
